Synthetic adult speech fixtures, created for the overnight build on 2026-09-05.
No student recording or personal data. Texts are authored for this test.

Generate locally with eSpeak NG (130 words/minute):

    espeak-ng -v en -s 130 -f synthetic-en.txt -w synthetic-en.wav
    espeak-ng -v it -s 130 -f synthetic-it.txt -w synthetic-it.wav

These measure the transcription path on synthetic speech only. They do not
establish accuracy on children's voices, accents, background noise or handwriting.
